thread:
omar.s: Hey team — emergency situation, I'm temporary guardian for my 10yo niece while her parents sort custody. Can I add her to my Redwood benefits now? What docs do you need and how fast can this happen?

maria.peopleops: Hi Omar, sorry to hear that. Yes, a change in legal guardianship or placement can be a Qualifying Life Event (QLE). You have 30 days from the date you became guardian to submit.

omar.s: We have a notarized temporary guardianship affidavit and school enrollment showing her at my address. Will that be enough?

maria.peopleops: Those are the most common proofs and usually sufficient: notarized temporary guardianship, school records with your address, DMV or state ID for the child, or a placement order. If the court issues a later decree we can update records.

omar.s: Any special handling because it's temporary? The guardianship is for 90 days initially.

maria.peopleops: Temporary guardianship still qualifies. We'll submit docs to each carrier; some carriers ask for expiry dates on temporary docs. If they need more, we'll notify you and request supplemental proof.

omar.s: How do I submit? Portal or email? Any subject line?

maria.peopleops: Email benefits@redwood.com with subject exactly: "QLE: Add dependent - temporary guardianship - <Omar S>" and attach PDFs. Or upload via People Ops portal > Benefits > QLE uploads. benefits-bot will ack and create a case.

benefits-bot: Upload received (if attached). Case #RB-2479 created. Carrier verification usually 3-10 business days; temporary docs can add a bit of follow-up.

omar.s: Payroll/deduction question — if accepted mid-pay-period, will I be charged a full month?

luke.payroll: Hi Omar 8 payroll here. If the carrier sets the effective date to your guardianship date and it falls inside our payroll cutoff, we prorate the premium for the pay period. If carrier makes the effective date the 1st of next month, deductions start then. We'll estimate and confirm before payroll posts.

omar.s: We have a pediatric appointment in 6 days. If coverage isn't confirmed by then, will the clinic bill me? Any way to get a letter?

maria.peopleops: For urgent care we can request a predetermination/coverage letter from the carrier using the temporary guardianship affidavit. DM me provider + appt date and we'll push the broker to expedite. Doctors often accept the coverage letter for in-network billing.

omar.s: Thanks. Uploading the notarized affidavit and school enrollment now. Please ping when the carrier confirms.

benefits-bot: Files received. Case #RB-2479 updated. We'll post carrier responses in this thread.

maria.peopleops: Got it. Once carrier confirms we'll post effective date and estimated payroll impact. If you need us to nudge payroll for an adjustment, say so in this thread and Luke will prioritize. :thumbsup:
